# ui::testing::TestContextMenuHost

Header: `winui/testing/TestContextMenuHost.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::ContextMenuHost`.

[ContextMenuHost](../rendering/context-menu-host.md) test double: records every menu a control asks to show and answers with a scripted choice instead of opening a popup.

Script the answer with [pick()](#pick) (by visible text) or [pick_index()](#pick_index) before the control's [Element::handle_context_menu()](../tree/element.md#handle_context_menu) runs; the script applies to the next [show()](#show) only and then resets to a dismissal. Like the real menu, a separator or a disabled item can't be picked, so scripting one reads as a dismissal.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::HeadlessTextMeasurer measurer;
ui::TextControl block{"orange text"};
block.set_selection_enabled(true);
(void)block.measure({400, 30}, measurer, ui::Theme::default_light());
block.arrange({0, 0, 400, 30});
block.select(0, 6);
ui::testing::set_focused(block, true);

ui::testing::TestClipboard       clipboard;
ui::testing::TestContextMenuHost menu;
ui::testing::set_clipboard(&clipboard);
menu.pick("Copy");
REQUIRE(block.handle_context_menu(ui::Point{5, 5}, menu));
REQUIRE(menu.show_count() == 1);
REQUIRE(clipboard.text() == "orange");
```

## pick

```cpp
void pick(std::string text)
```

Makes the next [show()](#show) choose the first non-separator item whose text equals `text`. Overrides an earlier [pick_index()](#pick_index); no match (or a disabled match) dismisses.

## pick_index

```cpp
void pick_index(std::size_t index)
```

Makes the next [show()](#show) choose the item at `index` (separators count). Overrides an earlier [pick()](#pick); an out-of-range, separator or disabled index dismisses.

## show_count

```cpp
int show_count() const
```

How many menus have been shown over this host's lifetime.

## last_items

```cpp
const std::vector<ContextMenuItem>& last_items() const
```

The items of the most recent [show()](#show) (empty before the first one).

## last_position

```cpp
Point last_position() const
```

Where the most recent menu was anchored, in window DIPs (the caret for a keyboard-invoked menu).

## last_texts

```cpp
std::vector<std::string> last_texts() const
```

The last menu's item texts, separators as empty strings.

## enabled

```cpp
std::optional<bool> enabled(const std::string& text) const
```

The enabled state of the last menu's item with visible text `text` (nullopt: absent).

## show

```cpp
std::optional<std::size_t> show(Point position, const std::vector<ContextMenuItem>& items) override
```

Records `position`/`items`, bumps [show_count()](#show_count), and returns the scripted choice (then clears the script). Returns nullopt, a dismissal, when nothing pickable was scripted.
